ayahs.textArabic: الۤمّۤصۤ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Alif lām mīm ṣād.
ayahs.textEnglish: Alif. Lam. Mim. Sad.

ayahs.textArabic: كِتٰبٌ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكَ فَلَا يَكُنْ فِيْ صَدْرِكَ حَرَجٌ مِّنْهُ لِتُنْذِرَ بِهٖ وَذِكْرٰى لِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Kitābun unzila ilaika falā yakun fī ṣadrika ḥarajum minhu litunżira bihī wa żikrā lil-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: A DIVINE WRIT has been bestowed from on high upon thee -and let there be no doubt about this in thy heart-in order that thou mayest warn [the erring] thereby, and [thus] admonish the believers:

ayahs.textArabic: اِتَّبِعُوْا مَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكُمْ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖٓ اَوْلِيَاۤءَۗ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ittabi‘ū mā unzila ilaikum mir rabbikum wa lā tattabi‘ū min dūnihī auliyā'(a), qalīlam mā tażakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: "Follow what has been sent down unto you by your Sustainer, and follow no masters other than Him. How seldom do you keep this in mind!

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَمْ مِّنْ قَرْيَةٍ اَهْلَكْنٰهَا فَجَاۤءَهَا بَأْسُنَا بَيَاتًا اَوْ هُمْ قَاۤىِٕلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa kam min qaryatin ahlaknāhā fa jā'ahā ba'sunā bayātan au hum qā'ilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And how many a [rebellious] community have We destroyed, with Our punishment coming upon it by night, or while they were resting at noontide!

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا كَانَ دَعْوٰىهُمْ اِذْ جَاۤءَهُمْ بَأْسُنَآ اِلَّآ اَنْ قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Famā kāna da‘wāhum iż jā'ahum ba'sunā illā an qālū innā kunnā ẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And when Our punishment came upon them, they had nothing to say for themselves, and could only cry, "Verily, we were wrongdoers!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَنَسْـَٔلَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اُرْسِلَ اِلَيْهِمْ وَلَنَسْـَٔلَنَّ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa lanas'alannal-lażīna ursila ilaihim wa lanas'alannal-mursalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thus, [on Judgment Day] We shall most certainly call to account all those unto whom a [divine] message was sent, and We shall most certainly call to account the message-bearers [themselves];

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَنَقُصَّنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ بِعِلْمٍ وَّمَا كُنَّا غَاۤىِٕبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa lanaquṣṣanna ‘alaihim bi‘ilmiw wa mā kunnā gā'ibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and thereupon We shall most certainly reveal unto them Our knowledge [of their doings]: for never have We been absent [from them].

ayahs.textArabic: وَالْوَزْنُ يَوْمَىِٕذِ ِۨالْحَقُّۚ فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِيْنُهٗ فَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-waznu yauma'iżinil-ḥaqq(u), faman ṡaqulat mawāzīnuhū fa ulā'ika humul-mufliḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And true will be the weighing on that Day; and those whose weight [of good deeds] is heavy in the balance -it is they, they who shall attain to a happy state;

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِيْنُهٗ فَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ الَّذِيْنَ خَسِرُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يَظْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa man khaffat mawāzīnuhū fa ulā'ikal-lażīna khasirū anfusahum bimā kānū bi'āyātinā yaẓlimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: whereas those whose weight is light in the balance - it is they who will have squandered their own selves by their wilful rejection of Our messages.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنّٰكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيْهَا مَعَايِشَۗ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad makkannākum fil-arḍi wa ja‘alnā lakum fīhā ma‘āyisy(a), qalīlam mā tasykurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: YEA, INDEED, [O men,] We have given you a [bountiful] place on earth, and appointed thereon means of livelihood for you: [yet] how seldom are you grateful!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنٰكُمْ ثُمَّ صَوَّرْنٰكُمْ ثُمَّ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةِ اسْجُدُوْا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوْٓا اِلَّآ اِبْلِيْسَۗ  لَمْ يَكُنْ مِّنَ السّٰجِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad khalaqnākum ṡumma ṣawwarnākum ṡumma qulnā lil-malā'ikatisjudū li'ādama fa sajadū illā iblīs(a), lam yakum minas-sājidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yea, indeed, We have created you, and then formed you; and then We said unto the angels, "Prostrate yourselves before Adam!" - whereupon they [all] prostrated themselves, save Iblis: he was not among those who prostrated themselves.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ اَلَّا تَسْجُدَ اِذْ اَمَرْتُكَ ۗقَالَ اَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُۚ خَلَقْتَنِيْ مِنْ نَّارٍ وَّخَلَقْتَهٗ مِنْ طِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla mā mana‘aka allā tasjuda iż amartuk(a), qāla ana khairum minh(u), khalaqtanī min nāriw wa khalaqtahū min ṭīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And God] said: "What has kept thee from prostrating thyself when I commanded thee?" Answered [Iblis]: "I am better than he: Thou hast created me out of fire, whereas him Thou hast created out of clay."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَاهْبِطْ مِنْهَا فَمَا يَكُوْنُ لَكَ اَنْ تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيْهَا فَاخْرُجْ اِنَّكَ مِنَ الصّٰغِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla fahbiṭ minhā famā yakūnu laka an tatakabbara fīhā fakhruj innaka minaṣ-ṣāgirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [God] said: "Down with thee, then, from this [state] -for it is not meet for thee to show arrogance here! Go forth, then: verily, among the humiliated shalt thou be!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اَنْظِرْنِيْٓ اِلٰى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla anẓirnī ilā yaumi yub‘aṡūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Iblis]: "Grant me a respite till the Day when all shall be raised from the dead."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla innaka minal-munẓarīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And God] replied: "Verily, thou shalt be among those who are granted a respite."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَبِمَآ اَغْوَيْتَنِيْ لَاَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَاطَكَ الْمُسْتَقِيْمَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla fabimā agwaitanī la'aq‘udanna lahum  ṣirāṭakal-mustaqīm(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Whereupon Iblis] said: "Now that Thou hast thwarted me," shall most certainly lie in ambush for them all along Thy straight way,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ لَاٰتِيَنَّهُمْ مِّنْۢ بَيْنِ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ وَعَنْ اَيْمَانِهِمْ وَعَنْ شَمَاۤىِٕلِهِمْۗ وَلَا تَجِدُ اَكْثَرَهُمْ شٰكِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma la'ātiyannahum mim baini aidīhim wa min khalfihim wa ‘an aimānihim wa ‘an syamā'ilihim, wa lā tajidu akṡarahum syākirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and shall most certainly fall upon them openly as well as in a manner beyond their ken, and from their right and from their left: and most of them Thou wilt find ungrateful."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اخْرُجْ مِنْهَا مَذْءُوْمًا مَّدْحُوْرًا ۗ لَمَنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ لَاَمْلَـَٔنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālakhruj minhā maż'ūmam madḥūrā(n), laman tabi‘aka minhum la'amla'anna  jahannama minkum ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And God] said: "Go forth from here, disgraced and disowned! [And] as for such of them as follow thee - I will most certainly fill hell with you all!

ayahs.textArabic: وَيٰٓاٰدَمُ اسْكُنْ اَنْتَ وَزَوْجُكَ الْجَنَّةَ فَكُلَا مِنْ حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هٰذِهِ الشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُوْنَا مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yā ādamuskun anta wa zaujukal-jannata fa kulā min ḥaiṡu syi'tumā wa lā taqrabā hāżihisy-syajarata fa takūnā minaẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [as for thee], O Adam', dwell thou and thy wife in this garden, and eat, both of you, whatever you may wish; but do not approach this one tree, lest you become evildoers!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَسْوَسَ لَهُمَا الشَّيْطٰنُ لِيُبْدِيَ لَهُمَا مَا وٗرِيَ عَنْهُمَا مِنْ سَوْءٰتِهِمَا وَقَالَ مَا نَهٰىكُمَا رَبُّكُمَا عَنْ هٰذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ اِلَّآ اَنْ تَكُوْنَا مَلَكَيْنِ اَوْ تَكُوْنَا مِنَ الْخٰلِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa waswasa lahumasy-syaiṭānu liyubdiya lahumā mā wūriya ‘anhumā min sau'ātihimā wa qāla mā nahākumā rabbukumā ‘an hāżihisy-syajarati illā an takūnā malakaini au takūnā minal-khālidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon Satan whispered unto the two with a view to making them conscious of their nakedness, of which [hitherto] they had been unaware; and he said: "Your Sustainer has but forbidden you this tree lest you two become [as] angels, or lest you live forever."

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَاسَمَهُمَآ اِنِّيْ لَكُمَا لَمِنَ النّٰصِحِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qāsamahumā innī lakumā laminan-nāṣiḥīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And he swore unto them, "Verily, I am of those who wish you well indeed!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَدَلّٰىهُمَا بِغُرُوْرٍۚ فَلَمَّا ذَاقَا الشَّجَرَةَ بَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفٰنِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِنْ وَّرَقِ الْجَنَّةِۗ وَنَادٰىهُمَا رَبُّهُمَآ اَلَمْ اَنْهَكُمَا عَنْ تِلْكُمَا الشَّجَرَةِ وَاَقُلْ لَّكُمَآ اِنَّ الشَّيْطٰنَ لَكُمَا عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa dallāhumā bigurūr(in), falammā żāqasy-syajarata badat lahumā sau'ātuhumā wa ṭafiqā yakhṣifāni ‘alaihimā miw waraqil-jannah(ti), wa nādāhumā rabbuhumā alam anhakumā ‘an tilkumasy-syajarati wa aqul lakumā innasy-syaiṭāna lakumā ‘aduwwum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: -and thus he led them on with deluding thoughts. But as soon as the two had tasted [the fruit] of the tree, they became conscious of their nakedness; and they began to cover themselves with pieced-together leaves from the garden. And their Sustainer called unto them: "Did I not forbid that tree unto you and tell you, `Verily, Satan is your open foe'?"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ اَنْفُسَنَا وَاِنْ لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālā rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā wa illam tagfir lanā wa tarḥamnā lanakūnanna minal-khāsirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: The two replied: "O our Sustainer! We have sinned against ourselves -and unless Thou grant us forgiveness and bestow Thy mercy upon us, we shall most certainly be lost!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اهْبِطُوْا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ ۚوَلَكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَّمَتَاعٌ اِلٰى حِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālahbiṭū ba‘ḍukum liba‘ḍin ‘aduww(un), wa lakum fil-arḍi mustaqarruw wa matā‘un ilā ḥīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said He: "Down with you, [and be henceforth] enemies unto one another, having on earth your abode and livelihood for a while:

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فِيْهَا تَحْيَوْنَ وَفِيْهَا تَمُوْتُوْنَ وَمِنْهَا تُخْرَجُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla fīhā taḥyauna wa fīhā tamūtūna wa minhā tukhrajūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: there shall you live" - He added - "and there shall you die, and thence shall you be brought forth [on Resurrection Day]!

ayahs.textArabic: يٰبَنِيْٓ اٰدَمَ قَدْ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ لِبَاسًا يُّوَارِيْ سَوْءٰتِكُمْ وَرِيْشًاۗ وَلِبَاسُ التَّقْوٰى ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۗ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā banī ādama qad anzalnā ‘alaikum libāsay yuwārī sau'ātikum wa rīsyā(n), wa libāsut-taqwā żālika khair(un), żālika min āyātillāhi la‘allahum yażżakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: O CHILDREN of Adam! Indeed, We have bestowed upon you from on high [the knowledge of making] garments to cover your nakedness, and as a thing of beauty: but the garment of God-consciousness is the best of all. Herein lies a message from God, so that man” might take it to heart.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰبَنِيْٓ اٰدَمَ لَا يَفْتِنَنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطٰنُ كَمَآ اَخْرَجَ اَبَوَيْكُمْ مِّنَ الْجَنَّةِ يَنْزِعُ عَنْهُمَا لِبَاسَهُمَا لِيُرِيَهُمَا سَوْءٰتِهِمَا ۗاِنَّهٗ يَرٰىكُمْ هُوَ وَقَبِيْلُهٗ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا تَرَوْنَهُمْۗ اِنَّا جَعَلْنَا الشَّيٰطِيْنَ اَوْلِيَاۤءَ لِلَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā banī ādama lā yaftinannakumusy-syaiṭānu kamā akhraja abawaikum minal-jannati yanzi‘u ‘anhumā libāsahumā liyuriyahumā sau'ātihimā, innahū yarākum huwa wa qabīluhū min ḥaiṡu lā taraunahum, innā ja‘alnasy-syayāṭīna auliyā'a lil-lażīna lā yu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: O children of Adam! Do not allow Satan to seduce you in the same way as he caused your ancestors to be driven out of the garden: he deprived them of their garment [of God-consciousness] in order to make them aware of their nakedness. Verily, he and his tribe are lying in wait for you where you cannot perceive them! Verily, We have placed [all manner of] satanic forces near unto those who do not [truly] believe;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا فَعَلُوْا فَاحِشَةً قَالُوْا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهَآ اٰبَاۤءَنَا وَاللّٰهُ اَمَرَنَا بِهَاۗ قُلْ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَأْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشَاۤءِۗ اَتَقُوْلُوْنَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā fa‘alū fāḥisyatan qālū wajadnā ‘alaihā ābā'anā wallāhu amaranā bihā, qul innallāha lā ya'muru bil-faḥsyā'(i), ataqūlūna ‘alallāhi mā lā ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [so,] whenever they commit a shameful deed, they are wont to say, "We found our forefathers doing it," and, "God has enjoined it upon us." Say: "Behold, never does God enjoin deeds of abomination. Would you attribute unto God something of which you have no knowledge?"

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اَمَرَ رَبِّيْ بِالْقِسْطِۗ وَاَقِيْمُوْا وُجُوْهَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَّادْعُوْهُ مُخْلِصِيْنَ لَهُ الدِّيْنَ ەۗ كَمَا بَدَاَكُمْ تَعُوْدُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul amara rabbī bil-qisṭ(i), wa aqīmū wujūhakum ‘inda kulli masjidiw wad‘ūhu mukhliṣīna lahud-dīn(a), kamā bada'akum ta‘ūdūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "My Sustainer has [but] enjoined the doing of what is right; and [He desires you to] put your whole being into every act of worship, and to call unto Him, sincere in your faith in Him alone. As it was He who brought you into being in the first instance, so also [unto Him] you will return:

ayahs.textArabic: فَرِيْقًا هَدٰى وَفَرِيْقًا حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الضَّلٰلَةُ  ۗاِنَّهُمُ اتَّخَذُوا الشَّيٰطِيْنَ اَوْلِيَاۤءَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ وَيَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّهُمْ مُّهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Farīqan hadā wa farīqan ḥaqqa ‘alaihimuḍ-ḍalālah(tu), innahumuttakhażusy-syayāṭīna auliyā'a min dūnillāhi wa yaḥsabūna annahum muhtadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: some [of you] He will have graced with His guidance, whereas, for some a straying from the right path will have become unavoidable: for, behold, they will have taken [their own] evil impulses for their masters in preference to God, thinking all the while that they have found the right path!"

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ يٰبَنِيْٓ اٰدَمَ خُذُوْا زِيْنَتَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَّكُلُوْا وَاشْرَبُوْا وَلَا تُسْرِفُوْاۚ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْرِفِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā banī ādama khużū zīnatakum ‘inda kulli masjidiw wa kulū wasyrabū wa lā tusrifū, innahū lā yuḥibbul-musrifīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: O CHILDREN of Adam! Beautify yourselves for every act of worship, and eat and drink [freely], but do not waste: verily, He does not love the wasteful!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ مَنْ حَرَّمَ زِيْنَةَ اللّٰهِ الَّتِيْٓ اَخْرَجَ لِعِبَادِهٖ وَالطَّيِّبٰتِ مِنَ الرِّزْقِۗ قُلْ هِيَ لِلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا خَالِصَةً يَّوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِۗ  كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْاٰيٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَّعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul man ḥarrama zīnatallāhil-latī akhraja li‘ibādihī waṭ-ṭayyibāti minar-rizq(i), qul hiya lil-lażīna āmanū fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā khāliṣatay yaumal-qiyāmah(ti), każālika nufaṣṣilul-āyāti liqaumiy ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "Who is there to forbid the beauty which God has brought forth for His creatures, and the good things from among the means of sustenance?" Say: "They are [lawful] in the life of this world unto all who have attained to faith - to be theirs alone on Resurrection Day." Thus clearly do We spell out these messages unto people of [innate] knowledge!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّيَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَالْاِثْمَ وَالْبَغْيَ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَاَنْ تُشْرِكُوْا بِاللّٰهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهٖ سُلْطٰنًا وَّاَنْ تَقُوْلُوْا عَلَى اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul innamā ḥarrama rabbiyal-fawāḥisya mā ẓahara minhā wa mā baṭana wal-iṡma wal-bagya bigairil-ḥaqqi wa an tusyrikū billāhi mā lam yunazzil bihī sulṭānaw wa an taqūlū ‘alallāhi mā lā ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "Verily, my Sustainer has forbidden only shameful deeds, be they open or secret, and [every kind of] sinning, and unjustified envy, and the ascribing of divinity to aught beside Him - since He has never bestowed any warrant therefor from on high and the attributing unto God of aught of which you have no knowledge."

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِكُلِّ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلٌۚ فَاِذَا جَاۤءَ اَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَأْخِرُوْنَ سَاعَةً وَّلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa likulli ummatin ajal(un), fa iżā jā'a ajaluhum lā yasta'khirūna sā‘ataw wa lā yastaqdimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And for all people a term has been set: and when [the end of] their term approaches, they can neither delay it by a single moment, nor can they hasten it.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰبَنِيْٓ اٰدَمَ اِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنْكُمْ يَقُصُّوْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِيْۙ فَمَنِ اتَّقٰى وَاَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā banī ādama immā ya'tiyannakum rusulum minkum yaquṣṣūna ‘alaikum āyātī, famanittaqā wa aṣlaḥa falā khaufun ‘alaihim wa lā hum yaḥzanūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: O CHILDREN of Adam! Whenever there come unto you apostles of your own, conveying My messages unto you, then all who are conscious of Me and live righteously - no fear need they have, and neither shall they grieve;

ayahs.textArabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوْا عَنْهَآ اُولٰۤىِٕكَ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِۚ هُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-lażīna każżabū bi'āyātinā wastakbarū ‘anhā ulā'ika aṣḥābun-nār(i), hum fīhā khālidūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: but they who give the lie to Our messages and scorn them in their pride-these are destined for the fire, therein to abide.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اَوْ كَذَّبَ بِاٰيٰتِهٖۗ اُولٰۤىِٕكَ يَنَالُهُمْ نَصِيْبُهُمْ مِّنَ الْكِتٰبِۗ حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَاۤءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا يَتَوَفَّوْنَهُمْۙ  قَالُوْٓا اَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ ۗقَالُوْا ضَلُّوْا عَنَّا وَشَهِدُوْا عَلٰٓى اَنْفُسِهِمْ اَنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا كٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Faman aẓlamu mimmaniftarā ‘alallāhi każiban au każżaba bi'āyātih(ī), ulā'ika yanāluhum naṣībuhum minal-kitāb(i), ḥattā iżā jā'athum rusulunā yatawaffaunahum, qālū aina mā kuntum tad‘ūna min dūnillāh(i), qālū ḍallū ‘annā wa syahidū ‘alā anfusihim annahum kānū kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And who could be more wicked than they who attribute their own lying inventions to God or give the lie to His messages? Whatever has been decreed to be their lot [in life] will be theirs -till there shall come _ unto them Our messengers to cause them to die, [and] shall say, "Where, now, are those beings whom you were wont to invoke beside God?" And [those sinners] will reply, "They have forsaken us!" -and [thus] they will bear witness against themselves that they had been denying the truth.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ ادْخُلُوْا فِيْٓ اُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ فِى النَّارِۙ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَتْ اُمَّةٌ لَّعَنَتْ اُخْتَهَا ۗحَتّٰٓى اِذَا ادَّارَكُوْا فِيْهَا جَمِيْعًا ۙقَالَتْ اُخْرٰىهُمْ لِاُوْلٰىهُمْ رَبَّنَا هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ اَضَلُّوْنَا فَاٰتِهِمْ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا مِّنَ النَّارِ ەۗ قَالَ لِكُلٍّ ضِعْفٌ وَّلٰكِنْ لَّا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāladkhulū fī umamin qad khalat min qablikum minal-jinni wal-insi fin-nār(i), kullamā dakhalat ummatul la‘anat ukhtahā, ḥattā iżaddārakū fīhā jamī‘ā(n), qālat ukhrāhum li'ūlāhum rabbanā hā'ulā'i aḍallūnā fa ātihim ‘ażāban ḍi‘fam minan-nār(i), qāla likullin ḍi‘fuw wa lākil lā ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And God] will say: "Join those hosts of invisible beings and humans who have gone before you into the fire!" [And] every time a host enters [the fire], it will curse its fellow-host -so much so that, when they all shall have passed into it, one after another, the last of them will speak [thus] of the first of them: "O our Sustainer! It is they who have led us astray: give, them, therefore, double suffering through fire!" He, will reply: "Every one of you deserves double suffering -but you know it not."

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَتْ اُوْلٰىهُمْ لِاُخْرٰىهُمْ فَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ فَضْلٍ فَذُوْقُوا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālat ūlāhum li'ukhrāhum famā kāna lakum ‘alainā min faḍlin fa żūqul-‘ażāba bimā kuntum taksibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And the first of them will say unto the last of them: "So you were in no wise superior to us! Taste, then, this suffering for all [the evil] that you were wont to do!"

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوْا عَنْهَا لَا تُفَتَّحُ لَهُمْ اَبْوَابُ السَّمَاۤءِ وَلَا يَدْخُلُوْنَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتّٰى يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِيْ سَمِّ الْخِيَاطِ ۗ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna każżabū bi'āyātinā wastakbarū ‘anhā lā tufattaḥu lahum abwābus-samā'i wa lā yadkhulūnal-jannata ḥattā yalijal-jamalu fī sammil-khiyāṭ(i), wa każālika najzil-mujrimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: VERILY, unto those who give the lie to Our messages and scorn them in their pride, the gates of heaven shall not be opened; and they shall not enter paradise any more than a twisted rope can pass through a needle's eye: for thus do We requite such as are lost in sin.

ayahs.textArabic: لَهُمْ مِّنْ جَهَنَّمَ مِهَادٌ وَّمِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ غَوَاشٍۗ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الظّٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Lahum min jahannama mihāduw wa min fauqihim gawāsy(in), wa każālika najziẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hell will be their resting-place and their covering as well: for thus do We requite the evildoers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا اِلَّا وُسْعَهَآ اُولٰۤىِٕكَ اَصْحٰبُ الْجَنَّةِۚ هُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lā nukallifu nafsan illā wus‘ahā, ulā'ika aṣḥābul-jannah(ti), hum fīhā khālidūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But those who attain to faith and do righteous deeds - [and] We do not burden any human being with more than he is well able to bear - they are destined for paradise, therein to abide,

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِيْ صُدُوْرِهِمْ مِّنْ غِلٍّ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ الْاَنْهٰرُۚ وَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ هَدٰىنَا لِهٰذَاۗ وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِيَ لَوْلَآ اَنْ هَدٰىنَا اللّٰهُ ۚ لَقَدْ جَاۤءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِالْحَقِّۗ وَنُوْدُوْٓا اَنْ تِلْكُمُ الْجَنَّةُ اُوْرِثْتُمُوْهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa naza‘nā mā fī ṣudūrihim min gillin tajrī min taḥtihimul-anhār(u), wa qālul-ḥamdu lillāhil-lażī hadānā lihāżā, wa mā kunnā linahtadiya lau lā an hadānallāh(u), laqad jā'at rusulu rabbinā bil-ḥaqq(i), wa nūdū an tilkumul-jannatu ūriṡtumūhā bimā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: after We shall have removed whatever unworthy thoughts or feelings may have been [lingering] in their bosoms. Running waters will flow at their feet; and they will say: "All praise is due to God, who has guided us unto this; for we would certainly not have found the right path unless God had guided us! Indeed, our Sustainer's apostles have told us the truth!" And [a voice] will call out unto them: "This is the paradise which you have inherited by virtue of your past deeds!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَادٰٓى اَصْحٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ اَصْحٰبَ النَّارِ اَنْ قَدْ وَجَدْنَا مَا وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا حَقًّا فَهَلْ وَجَدْتُّمْ مَّا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا ۗقَالُوْا نَعَمْۚ فَاَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ اَنْ لَّعْنَةُ اللّٰهِ عَلَى الظّٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nādā aṣḥābul-jannati aṣḥāban-nāri an qad wajadnā mā wa‘adanā rabbunā ḥaqqan fahal wajattum mā wa‘ada rabbukum ḥaqqā(n), qālū na‘am, fa ażżana mu'ażżinum bainahum al la‘natullāhi ‘alaẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And the inmates of paradise will call out to the inmates of the fire: "Now we have found that what our Sustainer promised us has come true; have you. too, found that what your Sustainer promised you has come true?" [The others] will answer, "Yes!"-whereupon from their midst a voice will loudly proclaim: "God's rejection is the due of the evildoers

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَّذِيْنَ يَصُدُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ وَيَبْغُوْنَهَا عِوَجًاۚ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ كٰفِرُوْنَۘ
ayahs.textLatin: Al-lażīna yaṣuddūna ‘an sabīlillāhi wa yabgūnahā ‘iwajā(n), wa hum bil-ākhirati kāfirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: who turn others away from God's path and try to make it appear crooked, and who refuse to acknowledge the truth of the life to come!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَبَيْنَهُمَا حِجَابٌۚ وَعَلَى الْاَعْرَافِ رِجَالٌ يَّعْرِفُوْنَ كُلًّا ۢ بِسِيْمٰىهُمْۚ وَنَادَوْا اَصْحٰبَ الْجَنَّةِ اَنْ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْۗ  لَمْ يَدْخُلُوْهَا وَهُمْ يَطْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa bainahumā ḥijāb(un), wa ‘alal-a‘rāfi rijāluy ya‘rifūna kullam bisīmāhum, wa nādau aṣḥābal-jannati an salāmun ‘alaikum, lam yadkhulūhā wa hum yaṭma‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And between the two there will be a barrier. And there will be persons who [in life] were endowed with the faculty of discernment [between right and wrong], recognizing each by its mark. And they will call out unto the inmates of paradise, "Peace be upon you!"-not having entered it themselves, but longing [for it].

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَاِذَا صُرِفَتْ اَبْصَارُهُمْ تِلْقَاۤءَ اَصْحٰبِ النَّارِۙ قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā ṣurifat abṣāruhum tilqā'a aṣḥābin-nāri qālū rabbanā lā taj‘alnā ma‘al-qaumiẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And whenever their eyes are turned towards the inmates of the fire, they will cry: "O our Sustainer! Place us not among the people who have been guilty of evildoing!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَادٰٓى اَصْحٰبُ الْاَعْرَافِ رِجَالًا يَّعْرِفُوْنَهُمْ بِسِيْمٰىهُمْ قَالُوْا مَآ اَغْنٰى عَنْكُمْ جَمْعُكُمْ وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nādā aṣḥābul-a‘rāfi rijālay ya‘rifūnahum bisīmāhum qālū mā agnā ‘ankum jam‘ukum wa mā kuntum tastakbirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they who [in life] had possessed this faculty of discernment will call out to those whom they recognize by their marks [as sinners], saying: "What has your amassing [of wealth] availed you, and all the false pride of your past?

ayahs.textArabic: اَهٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ الَّذِيْنَ اَقْسَمْتُمْ لَا يَنَالُهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِرَحْمَةٍۗ  اُدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَآ اَنْتُمْ تَحْزَنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ahā'ulā'il-lażīna aqsamtum lā yanāluhumullāhu biraḥmah(tin), udkhulul-jannata lā khaufun ‘alaikum wa lā antum taḥzanūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Are those [blessed ones] the self-same people of whom you once solemnly declared, `Never will God bestow His grace upon them'? [For now they have been told,] `Enter paradise; no fear need you have, and neither shall you grieve!"'

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَادٰٓى اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ اَصْحٰبَ الْجَنَّةِ اَنْ اَفِيْضُوْا عَلَيْنَا مِنَ الْمَاۤءِ اَوْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُ ۗقَالُوْٓا اِنَّ اللّٰهَ حَرَّمَهُمَا عَلَى الْكٰفِرِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nādā aṣḥābun-nāri aṣḥābal-jannati an afīḍū ‘alainā minal-mā'i au mimmā razaqakumullāh(u), qālū innallāha ḥarramahumā ‘alal-kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And the inmates of the fire will call out unto the inmates of paradise: "Pour some water upon us, or some of the sustenance [of paradise] which God has provided for you!" [The inmates of paradise] will reply: "Verily, God has denied both to those who have denied the truth -

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ اتَّخَذُوْا دِيْنَهُمْ لَهْوًا وَّلَعِبًا وَّغَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَيٰوةُ الدُّنْيَاۚ فَالْيَوْمَ نَنْسٰىهُمْ كَمَا نَسُوْا لِقَاۤءَ يَوْمِهِمْ هٰذَاۙ وَمَا كَانُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Al-lażīnattakhażū dīnahum lahwaw wa la‘ibaw wa garrathumul-ḥayātud-dun-yā, fal-yauma nansāhum kamā nasū liqā'a yaumihim hāżā, wa mā kānū bi'āyātinā yajḥadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: those who, beguiled by the life of this world, have made play and passing delights their religion! [And God will say:] "And so We shall be oblivious of them today as they were oblivious of the coming of this their Day [of Judgment], and as Our messages they did deny:

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ جِئْنٰهُمْ بِكِتٰبٍ فَصَّلْنٰهُ عَلٰى عِلْمٍ هُدًى وَّرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ji'nāhum bikitābin faṣṣalnāhu ‘alā ‘ilmin hudaw wa raḥmatal liqaumiy yu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, indeed, We did convey unto them a divine writ which We clearly, and wisely, spelled out - a guidance and a grace unto people who will believe."

ayahs.textArabic: هَلْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّا تَأْوِيْلَهٗۗ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيْ تَأْوِيْلُهٗ يَقُوْلُ الَّذِيْنَ نَسُوْهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ قَدْ جَاۤءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِالْحَقِّۚ فَهَلْ لَّنَا مِنْ شُفَعَاۤءَ فَيَشْفَعُوْا لَنَآ اَوْ نُرَدُّ فَنَعْمَلَ غَيْرَ الَّذِيْ كُنَّا نَعْمَلُۗ قَدْ خَسِرُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَفْتَرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Hal yanẓurūna illā ta'wīlah(ū), yauma ya'tī ta'wīluhū yaqūlul-lażīna nasūhu min qablu qad jā'at rusulu rabbinā bil-ḥaqq(i), fahal lanā min syufa‘ā'a fa yasyfa‘ū lanā au nuraddu fa na‘mala gairal-lażī kunnā na‘mal(u), qad khasirū anfusahum wa ḍalla ‘anhum mā kānū yaftarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Are [the unbelievers] but waiting for the final meaning of that [Day of Judgment] to unfold? [But] on the Day when its final meaning is unfolded, those who aforetime had been oblivious thereof will say: "Our Sustainer's apostles have indeed told us the truth! Have we, then, any intercessors who could intercede in our behalf? Or could we be brought back [to life] so that we might act otherwise than we were wont to act?" Indeed, they will have squandered their own selves, and all their false imagery will have forsaken them.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ فِيْ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰى عَلَى الْعَرْشِۗ يُغْشِى الَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهٗ حَثِيْثًاۙ وَّالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُوْمَ مُسَخَّرٰتٍۢ بِاَمْرِهٖٓ  ۙاَلَا لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَالْاَمْرُۗ تَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna rabbakumullāhul-lażī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin ṡummastawā ‘alal-‘arsy(i), yugsyil-lailan-nahāra yaṭlubuhū ḥaṡīṡā(n), wasy-syamsa wal-qamara wan-nujūma musakhkharātim bi'amrih(ī), alā lahul-khalqu wal-amr(u), tabārakallāhu rabbul-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: VERILY, your Sustainer is God, who has created the heavens and the earth in six aeons, and is established on the throne of His almightiness. He covers the day with the night in swift pursuit, with the sun and the moon and the stars subservient to His command: oh, verily, His is all creation and all command. Hallowed is God, the Sustainer of all the worlds!

ayahs.textArabic: اُدْعُوْا رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَّخُفْيَةً ۗاِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Ud‘ū rabbakum taḍarru‘aw wa khufūyah(tan), innahū lā yuḥibbul-mu‘tadīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Call unto your Sustainer humbly, and in the secrecy of your hearts. Verily, He loves not those who transgress the bounds of what is right:

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تُفْسِدُوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ بَعْدَ اِصْلَاحِهَا وَادْعُوْهُ خَوْفًا وَّطَمَعًاۗ اِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللّٰهِ قَرِيْبٌ مِّنَ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā tufsidū fil-arḍi ba‘da iṣlāḥihā wad‘ūhu khaufaw wa ṭama‘ā(n), inna raḥmatallāhi qarībum minal-muḥsinīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: hence, do not spread corruption on earth after it has been so well ordered. And call unto Him with fear and longing: verily, God's grace is ever near unto the doers of good!

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ يُرْسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ بُشْرًاۢ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهٖۗ حَتّٰٓى اِذَآ اَقَلَّتْ سَحَابًا ثِقَالًا سُقْنٰهُ لِبَلَدٍ مَّيِّتٍ فَاَنْزَلْنَا بِهِ الْمَاۤءَ فَاَخْرَجْنَا بِهٖ مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِۗ  كَذٰلِكَ نُخْرِجُ الْمَوْتٰى لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa huwal-lażī yursilur-riyāḥa busyram baina yadai raḥmatih(ī), ḥattā iżā aqallat saḥāban ṡiqālan suqnāhu libaladim mayyitin fa anzalnā bihil-mā'a fa akhrajnā bihī min kulliṡ-ṡamarāt(i), każālika nukhrijul-mautā la‘allakum tażakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And He it is who sends forth the winds as a glad tiding of His coming grace-so that, when they have brought heavy clouds, We may drive them towards dead land and cause thereby water to descend; and by this means do We cause all manner of fruit to come forth. Even thus shall We cause the \dead to come forth: [and this] you ought to keep in mind.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالْبَلَدُ الطَّيِّبُ يَخْرُجُ نَبَاتُهٗ بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهٖۚ وَالَّذِيْ خَبُثَ لَا يَخْرُجُ اِلَّا نَكِدًاۗ  كَذٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ الْاٰيٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَّشْكُرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-baladuṭ-ṭayyibu yakhruju nabātuhū bi'iżni rabbih(ī), wal-lażī khabuṡa lā yakhruju illā nakidā(n), każālika nuṣarriful-āyāti liqaumiy yasykurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: As for the good land, its vegetation comes forth [in abundance] by its Sustainer's leave, whereas from the bad it comes forth but poorly. Thus do We give many facets to Our messages for [the benefit of] people who are grateful!

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوْحًا اِلٰى قَوْمِهٖ فَقَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهٗۗ اِنِّيْٓ اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Laqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qaumihī fa qāla yā qaumi‘budullāha mā lakum min ilāhin gairuh(ū), innī akhāfu ‘alaikum ‘ażāba yaumin ‘aẓīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: INDEED, We sent forth Noah unto his people, and he said: "O my people! Worship God alone: you have no deity other than Him. Verily, I fear lest suffering befall you on an awesome Day!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ الْمَلَاُ مِنْ قَوْمِهٖٓ اِنَّا لَنَرٰىكَ فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālal mala'u min qaumihī innā lanarāka fī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: The great ones among his people replied: "Verily, we see that thou art obviously lost in error!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِيْ ضَلٰلَةٌ وَّلٰكِنِّيْ رَسُوْلٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla yā qaumi laisa bī ḍalālatuw wa lākinnī rasūlum mir rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Noah]: "O my people! There is no error in me, but I am an apostle from the Sustainer of all the worlds.

ayahs.textArabic: اُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّيْ وَاَنْصَحُ لَكُمْ وَاَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Uballigukum risālāti rabbī wa anṣaḥu lakum wa a‘lamu minallāhi mā lā ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: I am delivering unto you my Sustainer's messages and giving you good advice: for I know [through revelation] from God what you do not know.

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَعَجِبْتُمْ اَنْ جَاۤءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ عَلٰى رَجُلٍ مِّنْكُمْ لِيُنْذِرَكُمْ وَلِتَتَّقُوْا وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Awa‘ajibtum an jā'akum żikrum mir rabbikum ‘alā rajulim minkum liyunżirakum wa litattaqū wa la‘allakum turḥamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Why, do you deem it strange that a tiding from your Sustainer should have come unto you through a man from among yourselves, so that he might warn you, and that you might become conscious of God, and that you might be graced with His mercy?"

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَنْجَيْنٰهُ وَالَّذِيْنَ مَعَهٗ فِى الْفُلْكِ وَاَغْرَقْنَا الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَاۗ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا عَمِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa każżabūhu fa anjaināhu wal-lażīna ma‘ahū fil-fulki wa agraqnal-lażīna każżabū bi'āyātinā, innahum kānū qauman ‘amīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And yet they gave him the lie! And so We saved him and those who stood by him, in the ark, the while We caused those who had given the lie to Our messages to drown: verily, they were blind folk!

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَاِلٰى عَادٍ اَخَاهُمْ هُوْدًاۗ قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهٗۗ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ilā ‘ādin akhāḥum hūdā(n), qāla yā qaumi‘budullāha mā lakum min ilāhin gairuh(ū), afalā tattaqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND UNTO [the tribe of] `Ad [We sent] their brother Hud. He said: "O my people! Worship God alone: you have no deity other than Him. Will you not, then, be conscious of Him?"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ الْمَلَاُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ قَوْمِهٖٓ اِنَّا لَنَرٰىكَ فِيْ سَفَاهَةٍ وَّاِنَّا لَنَظُنُّكَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālal-mala'ul-lażīna kafarū min qaumihī innā lanarāka fī safāhatiw wa innā lanaẓunnuka  minal-kāżibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said the great ones among his people, who refused to acknowledge the truth: "Verily, we see that thou art weak-minded; and, verily, we think that thou art a liar!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِيْ سَفَاهَةٌ وَّلٰكِنِّيْ رَسُوْلٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla yā qaumi laisa bī safāhatuw wa lākinnī rasūlum mir rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Hud]: "O my people! There is no weak-mindedness in me, but I am an apostle from the Sustainer of all the worlds.

ayahs.textArabic: اُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّيْ وَاَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَاصِحٌ اَمِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Uballigukum risālāti rabbī wa ana lakum nāṣiḥun amīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: I am delivering unto you my Sustainer's messages and advising you truly and wells.

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَعَجِبْتُمْ اَنْ جَاۤءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ عَلٰى رَجُلٍ مِّنْكُمْ لِيُنْذِرَكُمْۗ وَاذْكُرُوْٓا اِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَاۤءَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوْحٍ وَّزَادَكُمْ فِى الْخَلْقِ بَصْۣطَةً ۚفَاذْكُرُوْٓا اٰلَاۤءَ اللّٰهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Awa‘ajibtum an jā'akum żikrum mir rabbikum ‘alā rajulim minkum liyunżirakum, ważkurū iż ja‘alakum khulafā'a mim ba‘di qaumi nūḥiw wa zādakum fil-khalqi basṭah(tan), fażkurū ālā'allāhi la‘allakum tufliḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Why, do you deem it strange that a tiding from your Sustainer should have come unto you through a man from among yourselves, so that he might warn you? Do but remember how He made you heirs to Noah's people, and endowed you abundantly with power: remember, then, God's blessings, so that you might attain to a happy state!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْٓا اَجِئْتَنَا لِنَعْبُدَ اللّٰهَ وَحْدَهٗ وَنَذَرَ مَا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ اٰبَاۤؤُنَاۚ فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū aji'tanā lina‘budallāha waḥdahū wa nażara mā kāna ya‘budu ābā'unā, fa'tinā bimā ta‘idunā in kunta minaṣ ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: "Hast thou come to us [with the demand] that we worship God alone, and give up all that our forefathers were wont to worship? Bring about, then, that [punishment] with which thou hast threatened us, if thou art a man of truth!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ قَدْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ رِجْسٌ وَّغَضَبٌۗ  اَتُجَادِلُوْنَنِيْ فِيْٓ اَسْمَاۤءٍ سَمَّيْتُمُوْهَآ اَنْتُمْ وَاٰبَاۤؤُكُمْ مَّا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ بِهَا مِنْ سُلْطٰنٍۗ فَانْتَظِرُوْٓا اِنِّيْ مَعَكُمْ مِّنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla qad waqa‘a ‘alaikum mir rabbikum rijsuw wa gaḍab(un), atujādilūnanī fī asmā'in sammaitumūhā antum wa ābā'ukum mā nazzalallāhu bihā min sulṭān(in), fantaẓirū innī ma‘akum minal-muntaẓirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Hud]: "You are already beset by loath some evils and by your Sustainer's condemnation! Do you argue with me about the [empty] names which you have invented - you and your forefathers - for which God has bestowed no warrant from on high? Wait, then, [for what will happen:] verily, I shall wait with you!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَنْجَيْنٰهُ وَالَّذِيْنَ مَعَهٗ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَمَا كَانُوْا مُؤْمِنِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa anjaināhu wal-lażīna ma‘ahū biraḥmatim minnā wa qaṭa‘nā dābiral-lażīna każżabū bi'āyātinā wa mā kānū mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so, by Our grace, We saved him and those who stood by him, the while We wiped out the last remnant of those who gave the lie to Our messages and would not believe.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِلٰى ثَمُوْدَ اَخَاهُمْ صٰلِحًاۘ قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهٗۗ قَدْ جَاۤءَتْكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْۗ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةُ اللّٰهِ لَكُمْ اٰيَةً فَذَرُوْهَا تَأْكُلْ فِيْٓ اَرْضِ اللّٰهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوْهَا بِسُوْۤءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ilā ṡamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥā(n), qāla yā qaumi‘budullāha mā lakum min ilāhin gairuh(ū), qad jā'atkum bayyinatum mir rabbikum, hāżihī nāqatullāhi lakum āyatan fa żarūhā ta'kul fī arḍillāhi wa lā tamassūhā bisū'in fa ya'khużakum ‘ażābun alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND UNTO [the tribe of] Thamud [We sent] their brother salih He said: "O my people! Worship God alone: you have no deity other than Him. Clear evidence of the truth has now come unto you from your Sustainer. "This she-camel belonging to God shall be a token for you: so leave her alone to pasture on God's earth, and do her no harm, lest grievous chastisement befall you.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاذْكُرُوْٓا اِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَاۤءَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ عَادٍ وَّبَوَّاَكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ تَتَّخِذُوْنَ مِنْ سُهُوْلِهَا قُصُوْرًا وَّتَنْحِتُوْنَ الْجِبَالَ بُيُوْتًا ۚفَاذْكُرُوْٓا اٰلَاۤءَ اللّٰهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ważkurū iż ja‘alakum khulafā'a mim ba‘di ‘ādiw wa bawwa'akum fil-arḍi tattakhiżūna min suhūlihā quṣūraw wa tanḥitūnal-jibāla buyūtā(n), fażkurū ālā'allāhi wa lā ta‘ṡau fil-arḍi mufsidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: "And remember how He made you heirs to [the tribe of] `Ad and settled you firmly on earth, so that you [are able to] build for yourselves castles on its plains and hew out mountains [to serve you] as dwellings: remember, then, God's blessings, and do not act wickedly on earth by spreading corruption."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ الْمَلَاُ الَّذِيْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا مِنْ قَوْمِهٖ لِلَّذِيْنَ اسْتُضْعِفُوْا لِمَنْ اٰمَنَ مِنْهُمْ اَتَعْلَمُوْنَ اَنَّ صٰلِحًا مُّرْسَلٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّهٖۗ قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا بِمَآ اُرْسِلَ بِهٖ مُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālal-mala'ul-lażīnastakbarū min qaumihī lil-lażīnastuḍ‘ifū liman āmana minhum ata‘lamūna anna ṣāliḥam mursalum mir rabbih(ī), qālū innā bimā ursila bihī mu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: The great ones among his people, who gloried in their arrogance towards all who were deemed weak, said unto the believers among them: "Do you [really] know that salih has been sent by his Sustainer?" They answered: "Verily, we believe in the message which he bears."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ الَّذِيْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْٓا اِنَّا بِالَّذِيْٓ اٰمَنْتُمْ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālal-lażīnastakbarū innā bil-lażī āmantum bihī kāfirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But] the arrogant ones said: "Behold, what you have come to believe in we refuse to regard as true!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَعَقَرُوا النَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا عَنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوْا يٰصٰلِحُ ائْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa ‘aqarun-nāqata wa ‘atau ‘an amri rabbihim wa qālū yā ṣāliḥu'tinā bimā ta‘idunā in kunta minal-mursalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And then they cruelly slaughtered the she-camel and turned with disdain from their Sustainer's commandment, and said: "O Salih! Bring about that [punishment] with which thou hast threatened us, if thou art truly one of God's message bearers!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَاَصْبَحُوْا فِيْ دَارِهِمْ جٰثِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa akhażathumur-rajfatu fa aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāṡimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon an earthquake overtook them: and then they lay lifeless, in their very homes, on the ground.

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَوَلّٰى عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يٰقَوْمِ لَقَدْ اَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَةَ رَبِّيْ وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ وَلٰكِنْ لَّا تُحِبُّوْنَ النّٰصِحِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa tawallā ‘anhum wa qāla yā qaumi laqad ablagtukum risālata rabbī wa naṣaḥtu lakum wa lākil lā tuḥibbūnan-nāṣiḥīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [Salih] turned away from them, and said: "O my people! Indeed, I delivered unto you my Sustainer's message and gave you good advice: but you did not love those who gave [you] good advice."

ayahs.textArabic: وَلُوْطًا اِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهٖٓ اَتَأْتُوْنَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُمْ بِهَا مِنْ اَحَدٍ مِّنَ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lūṭan iż qāla liqaumihī ata'tūnal-fāḥisyata mā sabaqakum bihā min aḥadim minal-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND [remember] Lot, when he said unto his people: "Will you commit abominations such as none in all the world has ever done before you?

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُوْنَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّنْ دُوْنِ النِّسَاۤءِۗ بَلْ اَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innakum lata'tūnar-rijāla syahwatam min dūnin-nisā'(i), bal antum qaumum musrifūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, with lust you approach men instead of women: nay, but you are people given to excesses!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهٖٓ اِلَّآ اَنْ قَالُوْٓا اَخْرِجُوْهُمْ مِّنْ قَرْيَتِكُمْۚ اِنَّهُمْ اُنَاسٌ يَّتَطَهَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā kāna jawāba qaumihī illā an qālū akhrijūhum min qaryatikum, innahum unāsuy yataṭahharūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But his people's only answer was this: "Expel them from your land! Verily, they are folk who make themselves out to be pure!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَنْجَيْنٰهُ وَاَهْلَهٗٓ اِلَّا امْرَاَتَهٗ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغٰبِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa anjaināhu wa ahlahū illamra'atahū kānat minal-gābirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon We saved him and his household except his wife, who was among those that stayed behind

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَّطَرًاۗ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa amṭarnā ‘alaihim maṭarā(n), fanẓur kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-mujrimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: the while We rained a rain [of destruction] upon the others: and behold what happened in the end to those people lost in sin!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِلٰى مَدْيَنَ اَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًاۗ قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهٗۗ قَدْ جَاۤءَتْكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ فَاَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيْزَانَ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشْيَاۤءَهُمْ وَلَا تُفْسِدُوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ بَعْدَ اِصْلَاحِهَاۗ ذٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ilā madyana akhāhum syu‘aibā(n), qāla yā qaumi‘budullāha mā lakum min ilāhin gairuh(ū), qad jā'atkum bayyinatum mir rabbikum fa auful-kaila wal-mīzāna wa lā tabkhasun-nāsa asy-yā'ahum wa lā tufsidū fil-arḍi ba‘da iṣlāḥihā, żālikum khairul lakum in kuntum mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND UNTO [the people of] Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb. He said: "O my people! Worship God alone: you have no deity other than Him. Clear evidence of the truth has now come unto you from your Sustainer. Give, therefore, full measure and weight [in all your dealings], and do not deprive people of what is rightfully theirs; and do not spread corruption on earth after it has be, en so well ordered: [all] this is for your own good, 'if you would but believe.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَقْعُدُوْا بِكُلِّ صِرَاطٍ تُوْعِدُوْنَ وَتَصُدُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ مَنْ اٰمَنَ بِهٖ وَتَبْغُوْنَهَا عِوَجًاۚ وَاذْكُرُوْٓا اِذْ كُنْتُمْ قَلِيْلًا فَكَثَّرَكُمْۖ وَانْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā taq‘udū bikulli ṣirāṭin tū‘idūna wa taṣuddūna ‘an sabīlillāhi man āmana bihī wa tabgūnahā ‘iwajā(n), ważkurū iż kuntum qalīlan fa kaṡṡarakum, wanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-mufsidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And do not lie in ambush by every road [that leads to the truth], threatening and trying to turn away from God's path all who believe in Him, and trying to make it appear crooked. And remember [the time] when you were few, and [how] He made you many: and behold what happened in the end to the spreaders of corruption!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنْ كَانَ طَاۤىِٕفَةٌ مِّنْكُمْ اٰمَنُوْا بِالَّذِيْٓ اُرْسِلْتُ بِهٖ وَطَاۤىِٕفَةٌ لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوْا فَاصْبِرُوْا حَتّٰى يَحْكُمَ اللّٰهُ بَيْنَنَاۚ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحٰكِمِيْنَ  ۔
ayahs.textLatin: Wa in kāna ṭā'ifatum minkum āmanū bil-lażī ursiltu bihī wa ṭā'ifatul lam tu'minū faṣbirū ḥattā yaḥkumallāhu bainanā, wa huwa khairul-ḥākimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: "And if there be some among you who have come to believe in the message which I bear, the while the others do not believe, then have patience in adversity till God shall judge between us [and them]: for He is the best of all judges!"

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قَالَ الْمَلَاُ الَّذِيْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا مِنْ قَوْمِهٖ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكَ يٰشُعَيْبُ وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَكَ مِنْ قَرْيَتِنَآ اَوْ لَتَعُوْدُنَّ فِيْ مِلَّتِنَاۗ قَالَ اَوَلَوْ كُنَّا كٰرِهِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālal-mala'ul-lażīnastakbarū min qaumihī lanukhrijannaka yā syu‘aibu wal-lażīna āmanū ma‘aka min qaryatinā au lata‘ūdunna fī millatinā, qāla awalau kunnā kārihīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said the great ones among his people, who gloried in their arrogance: "Most certainly, O Shu'ayb, we shall expel thee and thy fellow-believers from our land, unless you indeed return to our ways!" Said [Shu'ayb]: "Why, even though we abhor [them]?

ayahs.textArabic: قَدِ افْتَرَيْنَا عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اِنْ عُدْنَا فِيْ مِلَّتِكُمْ بَعْدَ اِذْ نَجّٰىنَا اللّٰهُ مِنْهَاۗ وَمَا يَكُوْنُ لَنَآ اَنْ نَّعُوْدَ فِيْهَآ اِلَّآ اَنْ يَّشَاۤءَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّنَاۗ وَسِعَ رَبُّنَا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًاۗ عَلَى اللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلْنَاۗ رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَاَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفٰتِحِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qadiftarainā ‘alallāhi każiban in ‘udnā fī millatikum ba‘da iż najjānallāhu minhā, wa mā yakūnu lanā an na‘ūda fīhā illā ay yasyā'allāhu rabbunā, wasi‘a rabbunā kulla syai'in ‘ilmā(n), ‘alallāhi tawakkalnā, rabbanaftaḥ bainanā wa baina qauminā bil-ḥaqqi wa anta khairul-fātiḥīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: We should be guilty of blaspheming against God were we to return to your ways after God has saved us from them! It is not conceivable that we should return to them-unless God, our Sustainer, so wills. All things does our Sustainer embrace within His knowledge; in God do we place our trust. O our Sustainer! Lay Thou open the truth between us and our people -for Thou art the best of all to lay open the truth!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ الْمَلَاُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ قَوْمِهٖ لَىِٕنِ اتَّبَعْتُمْ شُعَيْبًا اِنَّكُمْ اِذًا لَّخٰسِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālal-mala'ul-lażīna kafarū min qaumihī la'inittaba‘tum syu‘aiban innakum iżal lakhāsirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But the great ones among his people, who were bent on denying the truth, said [to his followers]: "Indeed, if you follow Shu'ayb, you will, verily, be the losers!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَاَصْبَحُوْا فِيْ دَارِهِمْ جٰثِمِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa akhażathumur-rajfatu fa aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāṡimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon an earthquake overtook them: and then they lay lifeless, in their very homes, on the ground -

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا شُعَيْبًا كَاَنْ لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيْهَاۚ  اَلَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا شُعَيْبًا كَانُوْا هُمُ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Al-lażīna każżabū syu‘aiban ka'allam yagnau fīhā, al-lażīna każżabū syu‘aiban kānū humul-khāsirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: they who had given the lie to Shu'ayb - as though they had never lived there: they who had given the lie to Shu'ayb -it was they who were the losers!

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَوَلّٰى عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يٰقَوْمِ لَقَدْ اَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّيْ وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْۚ فَكَيْفَ اٰسٰى عَلٰى قَوْمٍ كٰفِرِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa tawallā ‘anhum wa qāla yā qaumi laqad ablagtukum risālāti rabbī wa naṣaḥtu lakum, fa kaifa āsā ‘alā qaumin kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And he turned away from them, and said: "O my people! Indeed, I delivered unto you my Sustainer's message and gave you good advice: how, then, could I mourn for people who have denied the truth?"

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَرْسَلْنَا فِيْ قَرْيَةٍ مِّنْ نَّبِيٍّ اِلَّآ اَخَذْنَآ اَهْلَهَا بِالْبَأْسَاۤءِ وَالضَّرَّاۤءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَضَّرَّعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā arsalnā fī qaryatim min nabiyyin illā akhażnā ahlahā bil-ba'sā'i waḍ-ḍarrā'i la‘allahum yaḍḍarra‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND NEVER YET have We sent a prophet unto any community without trying its people with misfortune and hardship, so that they might humble themselves;

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ بَدَّلْنَا مَكَانَ السَّيِّئَةِ الْحَسَنَةَ حَتّٰى عَفَوْا وَّقَالُوْا قَدْ مَسَّ اٰبَاۤءَنَا الضَّرَّاۤءُ وَالسَّرَّاۤءُ فَاَخَذْنٰهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَّهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma baddalnā makānas-sayyi'atil-ḥasanata ḥattā ‘afau wa qālū qad massa ābā'anaḍ-ḍarrā'u was-sarrā'u fa akhażnāhum bagtataw wa hum lā yasy‘urūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: then We transformed the affliction into ease of life, so that they throve and said [to themselves], "Misfortune and hardship befell our forefathers as well -whereupon We took them to task, all of a sudden, without their being aware [of what was coming].

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوْ اَنَّ اَهْلَ الْقُرٰٓى اٰمَنُوْا وَاتَّقَوْا لَفَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَرَكٰتٍ مِّنَ السَّمَاۤءِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَلٰكِنْ كَذَّبُوْا فَاَخَذْنٰهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau anna ahlal-qurā āmanū wattaqau lafataḥnā ‘alaihim barakātim minas-samā'i wal ardḍi wa lākin każżabū fa akhażnāhum bimā kānū yaksibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet if the people of those communities had but attained to faith and been conscious of Us, We would indeed have opened up for them blessings out of heaven and earth: but they gave the lie to the truth - and so We took them to task through what they [themselves] had been doing.

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَاَمِنَ اَهْلُ الْقُرٰٓى اَنْ يَّأْتِيَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا بَيَاتًا وَّهُمْ نَاۤىِٕمُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Afa amina ahlul-qurā ay ya'tiyahum ba'sunā bayātaw wa hum nā'imūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Can, then, the people of any community ever feel secure that Our punishment will not come upon them by night, while they are asleep?

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَاَمِنَ اَهْلُ الْقُرٰٓى اَنْ يَّأْتِيَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا ضُحًى وَّهُمْ يَلْعَبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Awa amina ahlul-qurā ay ya'tiyahum ba'sunā ḍuḥaw wa hum yal‘abūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Why, can the people of any community ever feel secure that Our punishment will not come upon them in broad daylight, while they are engaged in (worldly] play?

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَاَمِنُوْا مَكْرَ اللّٰهِۚ فَلَا يَأْمَنُ مَكْرَ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْخٰسِرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Afa aminū makrallāh(i), falā ya'manu makrallāhi illal-qaumul khāsirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Can they, then, ever feel secure from God's deep devising? But none feels secure from God's deep devising save people who are [already] lost.

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لِلَّذِيْنَ يَرِثُوْنَ الْاَرْضَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ اَهْلِهَآ اَنْ لَّوْ نَشَاۤءُ اَصَبْنٰهُمْ بِذُنُوْبِهِمْۚ وَنَطْبَعُ عَلٰى قُلُوْبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Awalam yahdi lil-lażīna yariṡūnal-arḍa mim ba‘di ahlihā allau nasyā'u aṣabnāhum biżunūbihim, wa naṭba‘u ‘alā qulūbihim fahum lā yasma‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Has it, then, not become obvious unto those who have inherited the earth in the wake of former generations that, if We so willed, We could smite them [too] by means of their sins, sealing their hearts so that they cannot hear [the truth]?

ayahs.textArabic: تِلْكَ الْقُرٰى نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ اَنْۢبَاۤىِٕهَاۚ وَلَقَدْ جَاۤءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِۚ فَمَا كَانُوْا لِيُؤْمِنُوْا بِمَا كَذَّبُوْا مِنْ قَبْلُۗ  كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى قُلُوْبِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Tilkal-qurā naquṣṣu ‘alaika min ambā'ihā, wa laqad jā'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyināt(i), famā kānū liyu'minū bimā każżabū min qabl(u), każālika yaṭba‘ullāhu ‘alā qulūbil-kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Unto those [earlier] communities - some of whose stories We [now] relate unto thee -there had indeed come apostles of their own with all evidence of the truth; but they would not believe in anything to which they had once given the lie: thus it is that God seals the hearts of those who deny the truth;

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا وَجَدْنَا لِاَكْثَرِهِمْ مِّنْ عَهْدٍۚ وَاِنْ وَّجَدْنَآ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَفٰسِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā wajadnā li'akṡarihim min ‘ahd(in), wa iw wajadnā akṡarahum lafāsiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and in most of them We found no [inner] bond with anything that is right -and most of them We found to be iniquitous indeed.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ مُّوْسٰى بِاٰيٰتِنَآ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَا۟ىِٕهٖ فَظَلَمُوْا بِهَاۚ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma ba‘aṡnā mim ba‘dihim mūsā bi'āyātinā ilā fir‘auna wa mala'ihī fa ẓalamū bihā, fanẓur kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-mufsidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND AFTER those [early people] We sent Moses with Our messages unto Pharaoh and his great ones, and they wilfully rejected them: and behold what happened in the end to those spreaders of corruption!

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ مُوْسٰى يٰفِرْعَوْنُ اِنِّيْ رَسُوْلٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qāla mūsa yā fir‘aunu innī rasūlum mir rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And Moses said: "O Pharaoh! Verily, I am an apostle from the Sustainer of all the worlds,

ayahs.textArabic: حَقِيْقٌ عَلٰٓى اَنْ لَّآ اَقُوْلَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الْحَقَّۗ قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ فَاَرْسِلْ مَعِيَ بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḥaqīqun ‘alā allā aqūla ‘alallāhi illal-ḥaqq(a), qad ji'tukum bibayyinatim mir rabbikum fa arsil ma‘iya banī isrā'īl(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: so constituted that I cannot say anything about God but the truth. I have now come unto you with a clear evidence from your Sustainer: let, then, the children of Israel go with me!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اِنْ كُنْتَ جِئْتَ بِاٰيَةٍ فَأْتِ بِهَآ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla in kunta ji'ta bi'āyatin fa'ti bihā in kunta minaṣ ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Pharaoh]: "If thou hast come with a sign, produce it-if thou art a man of truth!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَلْقٰى عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa alqā ‘aṣāhu fa iżā hiya ṡu‘bānum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon [Moses] threw down his staff, and lo! it was a serpent, plainly visible;

ayahs.textArabic: وَّنَزَعَ يَدَهٗ فَاِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاۤءُ لِلنّٰظِرِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa naza‘a yadahū fa iżā hiya baiḍā'u lin-nāẓirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and he drew forth his hand, and lo! it appeared [shining] white to the beholders.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ الْمَلَاُ مِنْ قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ عَلِيْمٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālal-mala'u min qaumi fir‘auna inna hāżā lasāḥirum ‘alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: The great ones among Pharaoh's people said: "Verily, this is indeed a sorcerer of great knowledge,

ayahs.textArabic: يُّرِيْدُ اَنْ يُّخْرِجَكُمْ مِّنْ اَرْضِكُمْ ۚ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yurīdu ay yukhrijakum min arḍikum, fa māżā ta'murūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: who wants to drive you out of your land! " [Said Pharaoh:] "What, then, do you advise?"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْآ اَرْجِهْ وَاَخَاهُ وَاَرْسِلْ فِى الْمَدَاۤىِٕنِ حٰشِرِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū arjih wa akhāhu wa arsil fil-madā'ini ḥāsyirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: "Let him and his brother wait awhile, and send unto all cities heralds

ayahs.textArabic: يَأْتُوْكَ بِكُلِّ سٰحِرٍ عَلِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Ya'tūka bikulli sāḥirin ‘alīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: who shall bring before thee every sorcerer of great knowledge."

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَاۤءَ السَّحَرَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ قَالُوْٓا اِنَّ لَنَا لَاَجْرًا اِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغٰلِبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa jā'as-saḥaratu fir‘auna qālū inna lanā la'ajran in kunnā naḥnul-gālibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And the sorcerers came unto Pharaoh [and] said: "Verily, we ought to have a great reward if it is we who prevail."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَاِنَّكُمْ لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla na‘am wa innakum laminal-muqarrabīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Answered [Pharaoh]: "Yes; and, verily, you shall be among those who are near unto me."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا يٰمُوْسٰٓى اِمَّآ اَنْ تُلْقِيَ وَاِمَّآ اَنْ نَّكُوْنَ نَحْنُ الْمُلْقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū yā mūsā immā an tulqiya wa immā an nakūna naḥnul-mulqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They said: "O Moses! Either thou shalt throw [thy staff first], or we shall [be the first to] throw."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اَلْقُوْاۚ فَلَمَّآ اَلْقَوْا سَحَرُوْٓا اَعْيُنَ النَّاسِ وَاسْتَرْهَبُوْهُمْ وَجَاۤءُوْ بِسِحْرٍ عَظِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla alqū, falammā alqau saḥarū a‘yunan-nāsi wastarhabūhum wa jā'ū bisiḥrin ‘aẓīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: He answered: "You throw [first]." And when they threw down [their staffs], they cast a spell upon the people's eyes, and struck them with awe, and produced mighty sorcery.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَاَوْحَيْنَآ اِلٰى مُوْسٰٓى اَنْ اَلْقِ عَصَاكَۚ فَاِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa auḥainā ilā mūsā an alqi ‘aṣāk(a), fa iżā hiya talqafu mā ya'fikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [then] We inspired Moses, "Throw down thy staff!" -and lo! it swallowed up all their deceptions:

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa waqa‘al-ḥaqqu wa baṭala mā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: whereupon the truth was established, and vain was proved all that they had been doing.

ayahs.textArabic: فَغُلِبُوْا هُنَالِكَ وَانْقَلَبُوْا صٰغِرِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa gulibū hunālika wanqalabū ṣāgirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And thus were they vanquished there and then, and became utterly humiliated.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سٰجِدِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ulqiyas-saḥaratu sājidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And down fell the sorcerers, prostrating themselves

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْٓا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū āmannā birabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and] exclaiming: "We have come to believe in the Sustainer of all the worlds,

ayahs.textArabic: رَبِّ مُوْسٰى وَهٰرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbi mūsā wa hārūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: the Sustainer of Moses and Aaron!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ اٰمَنْتُمْ بِهٖ قَبْلَ اَنْ اٰذَنَ لَكُمْۚ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَمَكْرٌ مَّكَرْتُمُوْهُ فِى الْمَدِيْنَةِ لِتُخْرِجُوْا مِنْهَآ اَهْلَهَاۚ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla fir‘aunu āmantum bihī qabla an āżana lakum, inna hāżā lamakrum makartumūhu fil-madīnati litukhrijū minhā ahlahā, fa saufa ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said Pharaoh: "Have you come to believe in him ere I have given you permission? Behold, this is indeed a plot which you have cunningly devised in this [my] city in order to drive out its people hence! But in time you shall come to know, [my revenge]:

ayahs.textArabic: لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيْدِيَكُمْ وَاَرْجُلَكُمْ مِّنْ خِلَافٍ ثُمَّ لَاُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: La'uqaṭṭi‘anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilāfin ṡumma la'uṣallibannakum ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: most certainly shall I cut off your hands and your feet in great numbers, because of [your] perverseness, and then I shall most certainly crucify you, in great numbers, all together! "

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْٓا اِنَّآ اِلٰى رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū innā ilā rabbinā munqalibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: "Verily, unto our Sustainer do we turn-

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا تَنْقِمُ مِنَّآ اِلَّآ اَنْ اٰمَنَّا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّنَا لَمَّا جَاۤءَتْنَا ۗرَبَّنَآ اَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَّتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā tanqimu minnā illā an āmannā bi'āyāti rabbinā lammā jā'atnā, rabanā afrig ‘alainā ṣabraw wa tawaffanā muslimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for thou takest vengeance on us only because we have come to believe in our Sustainer's messages as soon as they came to us. O our Sustainer! Shower us with patience in adversity, and make us die as men who have surrendered themselves unto Thee!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ الْمَلَاُ مِنْ قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ اَتَذَرُ مُوْسٰى وَقَوْمَهٗ لِيُفْسِدُوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ وَيَذَرَكَ وَاٰلِهَتَكَۗ قَالَ سَنُقَتِّلُ اَبْنَاۤءَهُمْ وَنَسْتَحْيٖ نِسَاۤءَهُمْۚ وَاِنَّا فَوْقَهُمْ قٰهِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālal-mala'u min qaumi fir‘auna atażaru mūsā wa qaumahū liyufsidū fil-arḍi wa yażaraka wa ālihatak(a), qāla sanuqattilu abnā'ahum wa nastaḥyī nisā'ahum, wa innā fauqahum qāhirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And the great ones among Pharaoh's people said: "Wilt thou allow Moses and his people to spread corruption on earth, and to [cause thy people to] forsake thee and thy gods?" [Pharaoh] replied: "We shall slay their sons in great numbers and shall spare [only] their women: for, verily, we hold sway over them!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ مُوْسٰى لِقَوْمِهِ اسْتَعِيْنُوْا بِاللّٰهِ وَاصْبِرُوْاۚ اِنَّ الْاَرْضَ لِلّٰهِ ۗيُوْرِثُهَا مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖۗ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla mūsā liqaumihista‘īnū billāhi waṣbirū, innal-arḍa lillāh(i), yūriṡuhā may yasyā'u min ‘ibādih(ī), wal-‘āqibatu lil-muttaqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] Moses said unto his people: "Turn unto God for aid, and have patience in adversity. Verily, all the earth belongs to God: He gives it as a heritage - to such as He wills of His servants; and the future belongs to the God-conscious!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْٓا اُوْذِيْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ تَأْتِيَنَا وَمِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جِئْتَنَا ۗقَالَ عَسٰى رَبُّكُمْ اَنْ يُّهْلِكَ عَدُوَّكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفَكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū ūżīnā min qabli an ta'tiyanā wa mim ba‘di mā ji'tanā, qāla ‘asā rabbukum ay yuhlika ‘aduwwakum wa yastakhlifakum fil-arḍi fa yanẓura kaifa ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But the children of Israel] said: "We have suffered hurt ere thou camest to us and since thou hast come to us!" [Moses] replied: "It may well be that your Sustainer will destroy your foe and make you inherit the earth: and thereupon he will behold how you act."

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اَخَذْنَآ اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِيْنَ وَنَقْصٍ مِّنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad akhażnā āla fir‘auna bis-sinīna wa naqṣim minaṡ-ṡamarāti la‘allahum yażżakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And most certainly did We overwhelm Pharaoh's people with drought and scarcity of fruits, so that they might take it to heart.

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِذَا جَاۤءَتْهُمُ الْحَسَنَةُ قَالُوْا لَنَا هٰذِهٖ ۚوَاِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَّطَّيَّرُوْا بِمُوْسٰى وَمَنْ مَّعَهٗۗ  اَلَآ اِنَّمَا طٰۤىِٕرُهُمْ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa iżā jā'athumul-ḥasanatu qālū lanā hāżihī, wa in tuṣibhum sayyi'atuy yaṭṭayyarū bimūsā wa mam ma‘ah(ū), alā innamā ṭā'iruhum ‘indallāhi wa lākinna aksṡarahum lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But whenever good fortune alighted upon them, they would say, "This is [but] our due"; and whenever affliction befell them, they would blame their evil fortune on Moses and those who followed him. Oh, verily, their [evil] fortune had been decreed by God-but most of them knew it not.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْا مَهْمَا تَأْتِنَا بِهٖ مِنْ اٰيَةٍ لِّتَسْحَرَنَا بِهَاۙ فَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū mahmā ta'tinā bihī min āyatil litasḥaranā bihā, famā naḥnu laka bimu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they said [unto Moses]: "Whatever sign thou mayest produce before us in order to cast a spell upon us thereby, we shall not believe thee!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الطُّوْفَانَ وَالْجَرَادَ وَالْقُمَّلَ وَالضَّفَادِعَ وَالدَّمَ اٰيٰتٍ مُّفَصَّلٰتٍۗ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوْا وَكَانُوْا قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa arsalnā ‘alaihimuṭ-ṭūfāna wal-jarāda wal-qummala waḍ-ḍafādi‘a wad-dama āyātim mufaṣṣalāt(in), fastakbarū wa kānū qaumam mujrimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon We let loose upon them floods, and [plagues of] locusts, and lice, and frogs, and [water turning into] blood -distinct signs [all]: but they gloried in their arrogance, for they were people lost in sin.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمَّا وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّجْزُ قَالُوْا يٰمُوْسَى ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنْدَكَۚ  لَىِٕنْ كَشَفْتَ عَنَّا الرِّجْزَ لَنُؤْمِنَنَّ لَكَ وَلَنُرْسِلَنَّ مَعَكَ بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lammā waqa‘a ‘alihimur-rijzu qālū yā mūsad‘u lanā rabbaka bimā ‘ahida ‘indak(a), la'in kasyafta ‘annar-rijza lanu'minanna laka wa lanursilanna ma‘aka banī isrā'īl(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And whenever a plague struck them, they would cry: "O Moses, pray for us to thy Sustainer on the strength of the covenant [of prophethood] which He has made with thee! If thou remove this plague from us, we will truly believe in thee. and will let the children of Israel go with thee!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْزَ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ هُمْ بَالِغُوْهُ اِذَا هُمْ يَنْكُثُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā kasyafnā ‘anhumur-rijza ilā ajalin hum bāligūhu iżā hum yankuṡūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But whenever We removed the plague from them, giving them time to make good their promise, lo, they would break their word.

ayahs.textArabic: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَاَغْرَقْنٰهُمْ فِى الْيَمِّ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَكَانُوْا عَنْهَا غٰفِلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fantaqamnā minhum fa agraqnāhum fil-yammi bi'annahum każżabū bi'āyātinā wa kānū ‘anhā gāfilīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so We inflicted Our retribution on them, and caused them to drown in the sea, because they had given the lie to Our messages and had been heedless of them;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَوْرَثْنَا الْقَوْمَ الَّذِيْنَ كَانُوْا يُسْتَضْعَفُوْنَ مَشَارِقَ الْاَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا الَّتِيْ بٰرَكْنَا فِيْهَاۗ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ الْحُسْنٰى عَلٰى بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَۙ بِمَا صَبَرُوْاۗ وَدَمَّرْنَا مَا كَانَ يَصْنَعُ فِرْعَوْنُ وَقَوْمُهٗ وَمَا كَانُوْا يَعْرِشُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa auraṡnal-qaumal-lażīna kānū yustaḍ‘afūna masyāriqal-arḍi wa magāribahal-latī bāraknā fīhā, wa tammat kalimatu rabbikal-ḥusnā ‘alā banī isrā'īl(a), bimā ṣabarū, wa dammarnā mā kāna yaṣna‘u fir‘aunu wa qaumuhū wa mā kānū ya‘risyūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: whereas unto the people who [in the past] had been deemed utterly low, We gave as their heritage the eastern and western parts of the land that We had blessed. And [thus] thy Sustainer's good promise unto the children of Israel was fulfilled in result of their patience in adversity; whereas We utterly destroyed all that Pharaoh and his people had wrought, and all that they had built.

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَاوَزْنَا بِبَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ الْبَحْرَ فَاَتَوْا عَلٰى قَوْمٍ يَّعْكُفُوْنَ عَلٰٓى اَصْنَامٍ لَّهُمْ ۚقَالُوْا يٰمُوْسَى اجْعَلْ لَّنَآ اِلٰهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ اٰلِهَةٌ  ۗقَالَ اِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa jāwaznā bibanī isrā'īlal-baḥra fa atau ‘alā qaumiy ya‘kufūna ‘alā aṣnāmil lahum, qālū yā mūsaj‘al lanā ilāhan kamā lahum ālihah(tun), qāla innakum qaumun tajhalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND WE BROUGHT the children of Israel across the sea; and thereupon they came upon people who were devoted to the worship of some idols of theirs. Said [the children of Israel]: "O Moses, set up for us a god even as they have gods!" He replied: "Verily, you are people without any awareness [of right and wrong]!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ مُتَبَّرٌ مَّا هُمْ فِيْهِ وَبٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna hā'ulā'i mutabbarum mā hum fīhi wa bāṭilum mā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: As for these here -verily, their way of life is bound to lead to destruction; and worthless is all that they have ever done!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اَغَيْرَ اللّٰهِ اَبْغِيْكُمْ اِلٰهًا وَّهُوَ فَضَّلَكُمْ عَلَى الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla agairallāhi abgīkum ilāhaw wa huwa faḍḍalakum ‘alal-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] he said: "Am I to seek for you a deity other than God, although it is He who has favoured you above all other people?"

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ اَنْجَيْنٰكُمْ مِّنْ اٰلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُوْمُوْنَكُمْ سُوْۤءَ الْعَذَابِۚ يُقَتِّلُوْنَ اَبْنَاۤءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُوْنَ نِسَاۤءَكُمْۗ وَفِيْ ذٰلِكُمْ بَلَاۤءٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيْمٌ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż anjainākum min āli fir‘auna yasūmūnakum sū'al-‘ażāb(i), yuqattilūna abnā'akum wa yastaḥyūna nisā'akum wa fī żālikum balā'um mir rabbikum ‘aẓīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [he reminded them of this word of God]: "Lo, We saved you from Pharaoh's people who afflicted you with cruel suffering, slaying your sons in great numbers and sparing [only] your women - which was an awesome trial from your Sustainer."

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَوٰعَدْنَا مُوْسٰى ثَلٰثِيْنَ لَيْلَةً وَّاَتْمَمْنٰهَا بِعَشْرٍ فَتَمَّ مِيْقَاتُ رَبِّهٖٓ اَرْبَعِيْنَ لَيْلَةً ۚوَقَالَ مُوْسٰى لِاَخِيْهِ هٰرُوْنَ اخْلُفْنِيْ فِيْ قَوْمِيْ وَاَصْلِحْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ سَبِيْلَ الْمُفْسِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa wā‘adnā mūsā ṡalāṡīna lailataw wa atmamnāhā bi‘asyrin fa tamma mīqātu rabbihī arba‘īna lailah(tan), wa qāla mūsā li'akhīhi hārūnakhlufnī fī qaumī wa aṣliḥ wa lā tattabi‘ sabīlal-mufsidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND [then] We appointed for Moses thirty nights [on Mount Sinai]; and We added to them ten, whereby the term of forty nights set bye, his Sustainer was fulfilled. And Moses said unto his brother Aaron: "Take thou my place among my people; and act righteously, and follow not the path of the spreaders of corruption."

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمَّا جَاۤءَ مُوْسٰى لِمِيْقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهٗ رَبُّهٗۙ قَالَ رَبِّ اَرِنِيْٓ اَنْظُرْ اِلَيْكَۗ قَالَ لَنْ تَرٰىنِيْ وَلٰكِنِ انْظُرْ اِلَى الْجَبَلِ فَاِنِ اسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهٗ فَسَوْفَ تَرٰىنِيْۚ فَلَمَّا تَجَلّٰى رَبُّهٗ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهٗ دَكًّا وَّخَرَّ مُوْسٰى صَعِقًاۚ فَلَمَّآ اَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحٰنَكَ تُبْتُ اِلَيْكَ وَاَنَا۠ اَوَّلُ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lammā jā'a mūsā limīqātinā wa kallamahū rabbuh(ū), qāla rabbi arinī anẓur ilaik(a), qāla lan tarānī wa lākininẓur ilal-jabali fa inistaqarra makānahū fa saufa tarānī, falammā tajallā rabbuhū lil-jabali ja‘alahū dakkaw wa kharra mūsā ṣa‘iqā(n), falammā afāqa qāla subḥānaka tubtu ilaika wa ana awwalul-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And when Moses came [to Mount Sinai] at the time set by Us, and his Sustainer spoke unto him, he said: "O my Sustainer! Show [Thyself] unto me, so that I might behold Thee!" Said [God]: "Never canst thou see Me. However, behold this mountain: if it remains firm in its place, then - only then - wilt thou see Me. And as soon as his Sustainer revealed His glory to the mountain, He caused it to crumble to dust; and Moses fell down in a swoon. And when he came to himself, he said: "Limitless art Thou in Thy glory! Unto Thee do I turn in repentance; and I shall [always] be the first to believe in Thee!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ يٰمُوْسٰٓى اِنِّى اصْطَفَيْتُكَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بِرِسٰلٰتِيْ وَبِكَلَامِيْ ۖفَخُذْ مَآ اٰتَيْتُكَ وَكُنْ مِّنَ الشّٰكِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla yā mūsā inniṣṭafaituka ‘alan-nāsi birisālātī wa bikalāmī, fa khuż  mā ātaituka wa kum minasy-syākirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [God]: "O Moses! Behold, I have raised thee above all people by virtue of the messages which I have entrusted to thee, and by virtue of My speaking [unto thee]: hold fast, therefore, unto what I have vouchsafed thee, and be among the grateful!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَتَبْنَا لَهٗ فِى الْاَلْوَاحِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَّوْعِظَةً وَّتَفْصِيْلًا لِّكُلِّ شَيْءٍۚ فَخُذْهَا بِقُوَّةٍ وَّأْمُرْ قَوْمَكَ يَأْخُذُوْا بِاَحْسَنِهَا ۗسَاُورِيْكُمْ دَارَ الْفٰسِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa katabnā lahū fil-alwāḥi min kulli syai'im mau‘iẓataw wa tafṣīlal likulli syai'(in), fa khużhā biquwwatiw wa'mur qaumaka ya'khużū bi'aḥsanihā, sa'urīkum dāral-fāsiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And We ordained for him in the tablets [of the Law] all manner of admonition, clearly spelling out everything. And [We said:] "Hold fast unto them with [all thy] strength, and bid thy people to hold fast to their most goodly rules." I will show you the way the iniquitous shall go.

ayahs.textArabic: سَاَصْرِفُ عَنْ اٰيٰتِيَ الَّذِيْنَ يَتَكَبَّرُوْنَ فِى الْاَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّۗ وَاِنْ يَّرَوْا كُلَّ اٰيَةٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوْا بِهَاۚ وَاِنْ يَّرَوْا سَبِيْلَ الرُّشْدِ لَا يَتَّخِذُوْهُ سَبِيْلًاۚ وَاِنْ يَّرَوْا سَبِيْلَ الْغَيِّ يَتَّخِذُوْهُ سَبِيْلًاۗ ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَكَانُوْا عَنْهَا غٰفِلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Sa'aṣrifu ‘an āyātiyal-lażīna yatakabbarūna fil-arḍi bigairil-ḥaqq(i), wa iy yarau kulla āyatil lā yu'minū bihā, wa iy yarau sabīlar-rusydi lā yattakhiżūhu sabīlā(n), wa iy yarau sabīlal-gayyi yattakhiżūhu sabīlā(n), żālika bi'annahum każżabū bi'āyātinā wa kānū  ‘anhā gāfilīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: From My messages shall I cause to turn away all those who, without any right, behave haughtily on earth: for, though they may see every sign [of the truth], they do not believe in it, and though they may see the path of rectitude, they do not choose to follow it-whereas, if they see a path of error, they take it for their own: this, because they have given the lie to Our messages, and have remained heedless of them,"

ayahs.textArabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَلِقَاۤءِ الْاٰخِرَةِ حَبِطَتْ اَعْمَالُهُمْۗ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ اِلَّا مَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-lażīna każżabū bi'āyātinā wa liqā'il-ākhirati ḥabiṭat a‘māluhum, hal yujzauna illā mā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, all who give the lie to Our messages, and [thus] to the truth of the life to come -in vain shall be all their doings: [for] are they to be rewarded for aught but what they were wont to do?

ayahs.textArabic: وَاتَّخَذَ قَوْمُ مُوْسٰى مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ مِنْ حُلِيِّهِمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهٗ خُوَارٌۗ  اَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّهٗ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمْ وَلَا يَهْدِيْهِمْ سَبِيْلًاۘ اِتَّخَذُوْهُ وَكَانُوْا ظٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wattakhaża mūsā mim ba‘dihī min ḥuliyyihim ‘ijlan jasadal lahū khuwār(un), alam yarau annahū lā yukallimuhum wa lā yahdīhim sabīlā(n), ittakhażūhu wa kānū ẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND IN his absence the people of Moses took to worshipping the effigy of a calf [made] of their ornaments, which gave forth a lowing sound." Did they not see that it could neither speak unto them nor guide them in any way? [And yet] they took to worshipping it, for they were evildoers:

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمَّا سُقِطَ فِيْٓ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَرَاَوْا اَنَّهُمْ قَدْ ضَلُّوْاۙ قَالُوْا لَىِٕنْ لَّمْ يَرْحَمْنَا رَبُّنَا وَيَغْفِرْ لَنَا لَنَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lammā suqiṭa fī aidīhim wa ra'au annahum qad ḍallū, qālū la'il lam yarḥamnā rabbunā wa yagfir lanā lanakūnanna minal-khāsirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: although [later,] when they would smite their hands in remorse, having perceived that they had gone astray, they would say, "Indeed, unless our Sustainer have mercy on us and grant us forgiveness, we shall most certainly be among the lost!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمَّا رَجَعَ مُوْسٰٓى اِلٰى قَوْمِهٖ غَضْبَانَ اَسِفًاۙ قَالَ بِئْسَمَا خَلَفْتُمُوْنِيْ مِنْۢ بَعْدِيْۚ اَعَجِلْتُمْ اَمْرَ رَبِّكُمْۚ وَاَلْقَى الْاَلْوَاحَ وَاَخَذَ بِرَأْسِ اَخِيْهِ يَجُرُّهٗٓ اِلَيْهِ ۗقَالَ ابْنَ اُمَّ اِنَّ الْقَوْمَ اسْتَضْعَفُوْنِيْ وَكَادُوْا يَقْتُلُوْنَنِيْۖ فَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِيَ الْاَعْدَاۤءَ وَلَا تَجْعَلْنِيْ مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lammā raja‘a mūsā ilā qaumihī gaḍbāna asifā(n), qāla bi'samā khalaftumūnī mim ba‘dī, a‘ajiltum amra rabbikum, wa alqal-alwāḥa wa akhaża bira'si akhīhi yajurruhū ilaih(i), qālabna umma innal-qaumastaḍ‘afūnī wa kādū yaqtulūnanī, falā tusymit biyal-a‘dā'a wa lā taj‘alnī ma‘al-qaumiẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And when Moses returned to his people, full of wrath and sorrow, he exclaimed: "Vile is the course which you have followed in my absence! Have you forsaken your Sustainer's commandment?" And he threw down the tablets [of the Law], and seized his brother's head, dragging him towards himself. Cried Aaron: "O my mother's son! Behold, the people brought me low and almost slew me: so let not mine enemies rejoice at my affliction, and count me not among the evildoing folk!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَلِاَخِيْ وَاَدْخِلْنَا فِيْ رَحْمَتِكَ ۖوَاَنْتَ اَرْحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbigfirlī wa li'akhī wa adkhilnā fī raḥmatik(a), wa anta arḥamur-rāḥimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Moses]: "O my Sustainer! Grant Thou forgiveness unto me and my brother, and admit us unto Thy grace: for Thou art the most merciful of the merciful!"
